name: Tsutsumi Ayano
source: A bit shy and bashful. Although she is being blackmailed by the protagonist, she is a good-natured person who repeatedly falls into self-loathing after being successfully talked out of it. SHe tends to be a bit dependent on the protagonist, partly because they spend a lot of time together. She performs miscellaneous tasks such as gathering information at the protagonist's request.
